name: Rho GTPase activating protein 6
pathways: positive regulation of intracellular signal transduction

function.text: ARHGAP6 encodes rho GTPase-activating protein 6. Annotated molecular activities include GTPase activator activity and phospholipase activator activity. It participates in Rho protein signal transduction and positive regulation of intracellular signal transduction.
